Základom je zákon č. 108/2024 Z. z. o oc: The basis is Directive (EU) 2019/2161 of the European Parliament and of the Council, known as the Omnibus directive. In Slovakia it was transposed by Act No. 108/2024 Coll. on consumer protection, in force since 1 July 2024, which replaced Acts No. 250/2007 Coll. and No. 102/2014 Coll.
Zákon nepredpisuje jednu konkrétnu techn: The law does not prescribe one particular technology; it requires “reasonable and proportionate steps”. Do vyhľadávania napíš rewora a otvor Rew: Search for rewora and open Rewora Product Reviews ($4.99/month, 7-day free trial).
Zobrazí sa okno Install app so zoznamom: An Install app window appears listing the permissions the app needs. Confirm with Install.
Otvorí sa obrazovka Select a plan → prep: The Select a plan screen opens with a Pay monthly / Pay yearly switch. The Standard plan costs $4.99 / 30 days or $49.99 / year ($9 cheaper), with 7 days free. Click Select.
Na obrazovke Approve charge skontroluj p: On the Approve charge screen check the plan and click Approve.
Ak ti Shopify hlási „You don’t have any: If Shopify says “You don’t have any payment methods on file”, add a payment method first via Go to billing settings — otherwise Approve cannot be completed.
